title: Learning Expert Strategy for Autonomous Robotic Endovascular Intervention via Decoupled Procedural Execution
summary: Endovascular interventions are high-stakes procedures requiring precise device operation within complex and tortuous vascular anatomies. Autonomous endovascular navigation has the potential to standardize procedural quality and reduce the performance variability inherent in manual operation. Although Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches have demonstrated promise in enabling autonomy in endovascular intervention, they often struggle with explicit constraint satisfaction and safety guarantees. To address these challenges, a learning-based expert strategy is introduced, enhancing procedural consistency in autonomous endovascular intervention by explicitly decoupling high-level strategic decision-making from low-level procedural execution. The proposed framework replicates the expert clinical decision-making process: a strategic RL policy generates global navigation intents, which are subsequently refined through an expert-informed execution module. This module ensures that robot movements strictly adhere to expert operational norms, real-time kinematic limits, and vessel safety constraints. Experimental evaluation across high-fidelity 3D simulations and a real-world robotic platform demonstrates that the proposed framework not only outperforms baseline policies but also effectively replicates expert-level proficiency. The framework achieves a high navigation success rate (> 96%) and a 29.3% reduction in operational steps, which translates to enhanced operative efficiency and minimized device-vessel interaction. Furthermore, a 13% reduction in trajectory variance indicates superior procedural standardization, aligning autonomous behavior with established clinical norms. These results underscore its potential to enhance the predictability, safety, and consistency of robotic endovascular interventions.
tldr: This paper proposes a learning-based expert strategy for autonomous robotic endovascular navigation that decouples high-level strategic decision-making via RL from low-level procedural execution with expert constraints, achieving >96% success rate and 29.3% reduction in operational steps in simulations and real-world tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于学习的专家策略，用于自主机器人血管内导航，通过强化学习将高层战略决策与低层程序执行解耦，并引入专家约束，在仿真和真实测试中实现了超过96%的成功率并减少了29.3%的操作步骤。
summary_zh: 血管内介入治疗是一项高风险操作，需要在复杂迂曲的血管解剖结构中实现精确的器械操控。自主血管内导航有望规范操作质量，减少手动操作固有的操作变异性。尽管强化学习方法在实现血管内介入自主性方面展现出潜力，但在显式约束满足与安全保障方面仍存在不足。针对这些挑战，本文引入一种基于学习的专家策略，通过将高层级战略决策与低层级操作执行显式解耦，增强自主血管内介入的操作一致性。所提框架复现了临床专家决策过程：策略性强化学习策略生成全局导航意图，随后经由专家知识驱动的执行模块进行精细化处理。该模块确保机器人运动严格遵循专家操作规范、实时运动学限制及血管安全约束。在基于高保真三维仿真与真实机器人平台上的实验评估表明，所提框架不仅优于基线策略，更能有效复现专家级操作水平。该框架实现了高导航成功率（>96%）及29.3%的操作步骤缩减，转化为更高的操作效率与更低的器械-血管交互作用。此外，轨迹方差降低13%表明操作标准化程度显著提升，使自主行为与既定临床规范趋于一致。这些结果凸显了该框架在提升机器人血管介入操作可预测性、安全性与一致性方面的潜力。

title: Breaking Failure Cascades: Step-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Medical Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models have shown great promise in clinical image reasoning, but existing post-training pipelines remain predominantly outcome-centric, relying on final answer correctness or sequence-level preferences. This suffers from sparse credit assignment, making it difficult to optimize the reasoning process essential for clinical applications. Our analysis reveals that cascading errors from early-stage reasoning failures are a leading cause of incorrect predictions in medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks. Motivated by this, we propose Medical Reasoning-aware Policy Optimization (MRPO), an RL algorithm that incorporates step-wise process rewards. When the final answer is incorrect, MRPO assigns exponentially larger penalties to tokens in earlier invalid reasoning steps, breaking failure cascades without compromising successful paths. Across three multimodal LLM backbones, MRPO consistently outperforms standard GRPO and a recent RL baseline, and on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct even surpasses substantially larger medical MLLMs such as HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B by 2.79 points. Moreover, MRPO reduces early-stage reasoning failures from 64.0% to 13.0%, showing that targeted mitigation of cascading failures improves both reasoning quality and final answer accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/dmis-lab/MRPO
tldr: MRPO is a reinforcement learning algorithm that assigns step-wise process rewards with exponentially larger penalties to early invalid reasoning steps, effectively breaking failure cascades in medical multimodal reasoning and outperforming existing methods across multiple LLM backbones.
tldr_zh: MRPO是一种强化学习算法，通过对早期无效推理步骤施加指数级增大的惩罚来分配步骤级过程奖励，有效打破医学多模态推理中的失败级联，并在多个大语言模型骨干上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 近期多模态大语言模型在临床图像推理方面展现出巨大潜力，但现有的后训练流程仍以结果为中心，依赖最终答案正确性或序列级偏好。这导致稀疏的信用分配问题，难以优化对临床应用至关重要的推理过程。我们的分析表明，早期推理阶段级联错误是医学视觉问答基准中错误预测的主要原因。基于此，我们提出医学推理感知策略优化（MRPO）——一种引入步骤级过程奖励的强化学习算法。当最终答案错误时，MRPO会对早期无效推理步骤中的令牌施加指数级增大的惩罚，从而在不破坏成功路径的前提下打破失败级联。在三个多模态大语言模型主干上，MRPO始终优于标准GRPO及近期强化学习基线方法，在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上甚至超越参数量显著更大的医学多模态大模型（如HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B）2.79个百分点。此外，MRPO将早期推理失败率从64.0%降至13.0%，表明针对性缓解级联错误能同时提升推理质量与最终答案准确性。我们的代码已开源至https://github.com/dmis-lab/MRPO

title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
summary: As AI agents become increasingly capable of complex, long-horizon reasoning, rigorous and holistic evaluation is essential for measuring progress toward real-world healthcare applications. We introduce HealthAgentBench, a suite of 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories each with its unique environment. The benchmark suite spans diverse workflows throughout the patient journey and a broad range of modalities. Each task is designed to replicate an end-to-end clinical workflow: given minimal instructions, an agent must explore raw healthcare data, operate within a complex environment, and execute multi-step solutions that go beyond naive prompting. A final task success rate is reported to provide a single, interpretable metric for HealthAgentBench overall performance for each agent. Evaluating frontier agents on HealthAgentBench, we find that overall task success rate remains low, underscoring the difficulty of the suite. The strongest and the most cost effective agent, Codex GPT-5.5, achieves only approximately 42% success rate. Beyond aggregate performance, HealthAgentBench reveals nuanced strengths and weaknesses across task categories. Frontier agents show promise in automatically developing research modeling pipelines over EHR data, but medical imaging remains especially challenging, particularly for Claude Code models, while Codex GPT-5.5 shows emerging capability. Tasks that combine large search spaces with compositional reasoning requirements remain difficult for all current agents. Together, these results suggest that HealthAgentBench provides a challenging and realistic benchmark with substantial room for future progress. We release our benchmark at https://github.com/microsoft/HealthAgentBench.
tldr: HealthAgentBench is a benchmark suite of 54 realistic healthcare agentic tasks across 7 categories, evaluating frontier AI agents on end-to-end clinical workflows; best agent achieves only ~42% success rate, highlighting difficulty and room for progress.
tldr_zh: HealthAgentBench是一个包含54个真实医疗智能体任务的基准测试套件，涵盖7个类别，评估前沿AI代理在端到端临床工作流上的表现；最佳代理仅达到约42%的成功率，凸显了任务的难度和进步空间。
summary_zh:
摘要：
随着AI智能体在复杂、长程推理任务中能力日益增强，严格且全面的评估对于衡量其在真实世界医疗应用中的进展至关重要。我们提出HealthAgentBench，这一基准套件包含54项智能体医疗任务，涵盖7个类别，每个类别均配备独立环境。该基准套件覆盖患者就诊全流程中的多样化工作流及多种模态。每项任务旨在复现端到端临床工作流：给定最小化指令后，智能体必须探索原始医疗数据，在复杂环境中操作，并执行超越简单提示的多步骤解决方案。最终通过任务成功率报告，为各智能体在HealthAgentBench上的整体表现提供单一、可解释的指标。通过在HealthAgentBench上评估前沿智能体，我们发现总体任务成功率仍然较低，凸显了该套件的挑战性。最强且最具成本效益的智能体Codex GPT-5.5仅达到约42%的成功率。除整体表现外，HealthAgentBench还揭示了各任务类别中精细化的优势与不足。前沿智能体在基于电子健康记录（EHR）数据自动开发研究建模流程方面展现出潜力，但医学影像任务仍极具挑战，尤其是对Claude Code模型而言，而Codex GPT-5.5则表现出初步能力。所有当前智能体均难以应对同时涉及大搜索空间与组合推理要求的任务。综合来看，这些结果表明HealthAgentBench提供了一个具有挑战性且贴近实际的基准，为未来进步留下了巨大空间。我们已将基准套件发布于https://github.com/microsoft/HealthAgentBench。

title: Dense Structural Priors for Sparse Functional Landmark Localization in Surgical Videos
summary: Vision foundation models such as SAM 3 can provide transferable object-level structure across diverse surgical video conditions, but segmentation outputs do not explicitly encode the action-conditioned semantics that define functional surgical landmarks. Estimating instrument extent and geometry differs from localizing the tip or anchor relevant to clipping, grasping, or dissecting. We investigate vision foundation model-enabled sparse action-aware landmark localization, using zero-shot, point-prompted structural masks to provide dense instrument-level context without manual pixel-level mask annotations. We propose a lightweight refinement framework that uses SAM 3 as a structural prior. A coarse multi-frame network predicts tip and anchor prompts, generating non-oracle masks that are fused with visual and heatmap features to refine functional landmark predictions. We compare direct mask-augmented supervision, prediction-derived mask-prior refinement, and auxiliary mask supervision to examine how vision foundation model-derived structure should enter a precision-oriented localization system. Experiments on 7,867 clips from 60 surgical videos spanning YouTube, Cholec80, HeiChole, SurgVU, and CRCD evaluate the approach under heterogeneous conditions. Without manual pixel-level mask annotations for training, the proposed model achieves overall F1 scores of 72.4% for tip and 58.0% for anchor localization. Directly imposing masks on heatmap targets biases learning toward broad tool regions, whereas prediction-derived priors and auxiliary supervision provide effective intermediate structural guidance for action-dependent landmark prediction.
tldr: Proposes a lightweight framework using SAM 3 as a dense structural prior to predict functional landmarks (tip and anchor) in surgical videos without manual mask annotations, achieving strong F1 scores on diverse datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个轻量级框架，利用SAM 3作为密集结构先验，在没有手动掩码标注的情况下预测手术视频中的功能性地标（尖端和锚点），在多个数据集上取得了较高的F1分数。
summary_zh: 摘要：诸如SAM 3等视觉基础模型能够在多样化的手术视频条件下提供可迁移的物体级结构，但其分割输出并未显式编码定义功能性手术地标的动作条件化语义。评估器械范围与几何形态不同于定位与夹持、抓取或解剖相关的尖端或锚点。我们研究利用视觉基础模型实现的稀疏动作感知地标定位，通过零样本、点提示结构掩码提供密集的器械级上下文，无需人工像素级掩码标注。我们提出一个轻量级精炼框架，将SAM 3作为结构先验。一个粗粒度多帧网络预测尖端和锚点提示，生成非先验掩码，并与视觉特征和热图特征融合以精炼功能性地标预测。我们比较了直接掩码增强监督、预测导出掩码先验精炼以及辅助掩码监督，以探究视觉基础模型导出的结构应如何进入面向精度的定位系统。在包含来自YouTube、Cholec80、HeiChole、SurgVU和CRCD的60个手术视频的7,867个剪辑上进行的实验，在异质条件下评估了该方法。在未使用人工像素级掩码标注进行训练的情况下，所提模型在尖端定位上达到72.4%的整体F1分数，在锚点定位上达到58.0%。直接对热图目标施加掩码会使学习偏向大范围器械区域，而预测导出先验和辅助监督则为动作依赖地标预测提供了有效的中间结构引导。

title: The Quadruped Soft Tail: Compliant Grasping and Swabbing for Contamination Surveys in Harsh Environments
summary: Beryllium contamination surveys in radioactive areas are challenging for robots in environments cluttered with cables and electronics. To address this problem, we have developed a novel quadruped system augmentation: A lightweight, soft, and compliant tendon-actuated robotic tail mounted on a quadruped robot. The tail features a hollow, flexible backbone and a tendon-actuated soft gripper that enables the robot to pick up sampling tissues, swab contaminated surfaces, and release the tissues at designated collection locations for subsequent beryllium analysis. To enable intuitive teleoperation, a closed-form kinematic model and a singularity-robust task-space controller are developed. Experimental results demonstrate that gripper actuation has a negligible effect on robot shape, while common-mode tendon actuation provides an effective mechanism for stiffness modulation and preload control. Furthermore, experimental validation indicates that the proposed kinematic model provides a suitable basis for real-time task-space control. The proposed system combines the agility of legged locomotion with the compliance of soft robotic manipulation, enabling the complete contamination-survey procedure to be performed without human exposure. While motivated by beryllium contamination surveys at CERN, the proposed quadruped soft-tail concept is broadly applicable to legged robots operating in cluttered, confined, or hazardous environments where conventional rigid-link manipulators are undesirable.
tldr: A quadruped robot is augmented with a soft, tendon-actuated tail and gripper for compliant grasping and swabbing to perform beryllium contamination surveys in radioactive environments, with a kinematic model and task-space controller.
tldr_zh: 在四足机器人上安装了一个柔软的、肌腱驱动的尾巴和夹爪，用于在放射性环境中进行铍污染调查中的合规抓取和擦拭，并提出了运动学模型和任务空间控制器。
summary_zh: 铍污染调查在布满线缆和电子设备的放射性环境中对机器人构成了挑战。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种新型四足系统增强装置：一种轻量、柔软且柔顺的腱驱动机器人尾巴，安装于四足机器人上。该尾巴采用中空柔性骨架和腱驱动软体夹爪，使机器人能够拾取采样拭子、擦拭污染表面，并将拭子释放至指定收集位置以供后续铍分析。为实现直观的远程操作，我们建立了闭式运动学模型和奇异鲁棒任务空间控制器。实验结果表明，夹爪驱动对机器人形状的影响可忽略不计，而共模腱驱动则为刚度调节和预紧力控制提供了有效机制。此外，实验验证显示，所提出的运动学模型为实时任务空间控制提供了合适的基础。该系统结合了腿式运动的敏捷性与软体机器人操作的柔顺性，使得完整的污染调查流程可以在无人员暴露的情况下完成。尽管该研究源于欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）的铍污染调查需求，但所提出的四足软尾巴概念可广泛适用于在杂乱、受限或危险环境中运行的腿式机器人，而这类场景下传统刚性连杆机械臂并不理想。

title: Distilling Temporal Coherence into 2D Networks for Transrectal Ultrasound Prostate Video Segmentation
summary: Real-time video segmentation of the prostate in Transrectal Ultrasound (TRUS) is essential for image-guided interventions. While conventional 2D methods suffer from inter-frame inconsistencies by disregarding temporal context, 3D architectures incur prohibitive latency. To resolve this dilemma, we present a Temporally Consistent Learning Framework that distills temporal coherence into a 2D network during training, preserving single-frame inference efficiency. Our design is driven by a key clinical observation: the prostate exhibits geometric stability, whereas the surrounding acoustic environment fluctuates due to physiological motion and transducer pressure. Because conventional temporal constraints propagate erroneous gradients from these unstable regions, we introduce a Confidence-Weighted Temporal Consistency objective derived from optical flow warping residuals, selectively attenuating contributions from unreliable regions. Complementing this pixel-wise constraint, a Dual-scale Prototype Alignment Module enforces semantic coherence through contrastive optimization of local boundary and global semantic features. Furthermore, to eliminate the need for dense per-frame video annotations, we employ geometric equivariance-based pseudo-labeling with knowledge distillation from a pretrained teacher. Extensive experiments on SUN-SEG and our newly introduced TRUS-V benchmark (2,679 frames) demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy and temporal consistency at real-time speed. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/DYDevelop/DTC-TRUS.
tldr: This paper proposes a temporally consistent learning framework that distills temporal coherence from a 3D teacher into a 2D student network for real-time prostate video segmentation in transrectal ultrasound, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and consistency without requiring dense video annotations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种时间一致性学习框架，将时间连贯性从3D教师网络蒸馏到2D学生网络中，用于经直肠超声前列腺视频的实时分割，在无需密集视频标注的情况下实现了最先进的精度和时间一致性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
经直肠超声（TRUS）中的前列腺实时视频分割对于图像引导介入治疗至关重要。传统二维方法因忽略时序上下文而导致帧间不一致，而三维架构则存在过高的延迟。为解决这一困境，我们提出了一种时序一致学习框架，在训练过程中将时序连贯性蒸馏至二维网络，同时保留单帧推理效率。该设计基于一项关键临床观察：前列腺具有几何稳定性，而周围声学环境因生理运动和探头压力而产生波动。由于传统时序约束会从这些不稳定区域传播错误梯度，我们引入了一种基于光流变形残差的置信度加权时序一致性目标，选择性削弱不可靠区域的贡献。作为这种像素级约束的补充，双尺度原型对齐模块通过对局部边界和全局语义特征进行对比优化，强制实现语义连贯性。此外，为消除密集逐帧视频标注的需求，我们采用基于几何等变性的伪标签方法，并结合预训练教师模型的知识蒸馏。在SUN-SEG数据集以及我们新提出的TRUS-V基准（2679帧）上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法实现了实时速度下的最优精度和时序一致性。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/DYDevelop/DTC-TRUS。

title: Synergistic Perception-Reasoning Governance: Grounding Medical MLLMs with Verifiable Anatomical Evidence
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show strong promise for clinical VQA and radiology report generation, yet inference-time hallucinations still undermine trustworthy use: models can produce fluent conclusions that conflict with imaging evidence. Existing mitigation strategies typically rely on additional training, external retrieval/knowledge bases, or multi-stage post-hoc verification, which increases cost and pipeline complexity and often generalizes poorly across models and tasks.To address this, we propose a holistic, training-free evidence-injection framework that systematically mitigates hallucinations through dual-side evidence injection. By leveraging ROI priors acquired using MedSAM in our implementation, we recalibrate the visual perception trajectory via ROI-guided activation modulation while anchoring the textual reasoning trajectory by mapping anatomical coordinates into discrete semantic tokens as verifiable external memory. Then we introduce a task-aware dynamic router to select modality-specific interventions based on task semantics, balancing perceptual grounding and linguistic fluency. We conduct systematic evaluations on 2 tasks and 5 datasets using \texttt{LLaVA-1.5-7B}, \texttt{LLaVA-Med-1.5-7B}, \texttt{Qwen3-VL-8B/32B}, and \texttt{InternVL-3.5-8B/38B}. Controlled ablations and visualizations further validate the framework, which consistently outperforms baselines across medical benchmarks, improving close-ended accuracy by up to $\sim\mathbf{6}\%\uparrow$ and reducing open-ended hallucinations by $\sim\mathbf{35}\%\downarrow$. The code has been made available on GitHub: \href{https://github.com/Henry991115/SPRG}{\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/Henry991115/SPRG}}.
tldr: A training-free framework that mitigates hallucinations in medical MLLMs by injecting ROI-based visual evidence and anatomical coordinate-derived semantic tokens into the perception and reasoning trajectories, achieving up to 6% accuracy improvement and 35% hallucination reduction.
tldr_zh: 一种无需额外训练的框架，通过将基于ROI的视觉证据和解剖坐标转化的语义标记注入感知与推理轨迹中，缓解医学多模态大模型的幻觉问题，在多项基准上实现了高达6%的准确率提升和35%的幻觉率降低。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型在临床视觉问答和放射学报告生成中展现出巨大潜力，但推理时的幻觉问题仍阻碍其可信应用：模型可能生成与影像证据相悖的流畅结论。现有缓解策略通常依赖额外训练、外部检索/知识库或多阶段事后验证，这不仅增加了成本和流程复杂度，而且跨模型与任务泛化能力较差。为此，我们提出一种无需训练的整体性证据注入框架，通过双向证据注入系统地缓解幻觉。在实现中，我们利用MedSAM获取的感兴趣区域先验，通过ROI引导的激活调制重新校准视觉感知轨迹，同时将解剖坐标映射为离散语义标记作为可验证的外部记忆，从而锚定文本推理轨迹。随后引入任务感知动态路由器，根据任务语义选择特定模态的干预策略，在感知校准与语言流畅性间取得平衡。我们在2个任务、5个数据集上使用LLaVA-1.5-7B、LLaVA-Med-1.5-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B/32B和InternVL-3.5-8B/38B进行了系统评估。受控消融实验与可视化进一步验证了该框架，其在医疗基准上持续优于基线方法，闭式准确率提升约6%，开放式幻觉降低约35%。代码已开源在GitHub：https://github.com/Henry991115/SPRG。

title: Token-Sparse Medical Multimodal Reasoning via Dual-Stream Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) combining reinforcement learning (RL) ignite remarkable progress in multimodal reasoning, yet still struggle with medical images, which typically exhibit extremely sparse visual evidence to inform clinical decision-making. We recognize that pruning visual tokens outside the grounding region greatly enhances medical reasoning. However, a united RL framework for active visual token pruning (VTP) and medical multimodal reasoning remains unestablished. Here, we propose a dual-stream RL framework, ViToS, to fulfill token pruning and question answering. ViToS trains one policy model with two task branches, where one focuses on grounding while the other conducts token-sparse reasoning after VTP. Furthermore, we solve the coupled policy learning problem by introducing the cross-feedback sequential optimization, avoiding gradient conflict and facilitating convergence of the shared policy model. Evaluated on seven medical benchmarks, our method reduces visual tokens to 77% of the original sequence length while achieving a 108.27% relative performance on Lingshu-7B and 104.16% relative performance on HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B. Overall, ViToS delivers superior performance and inference speedup, establishing an efficient paradigm for medical multimodal reasoning.
tldr: ViToS proposes a dual-stream reinforcement learning framework that jointly learns visual token pruning and medical multimodal question answering, achieving 77% token reduction and improved performance on seven medical benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ViToS提出了一种双流强化学习框架，联合学习视觉令牌修剪和医学多模态问答，在七个医学基准上实现了77%的令牌缩减和性能提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）结合强化学习（RL）在多模态推理中激发了显著进展，但在医学图像上仍面临挑战——这类图像通常呈现极为稀疏的视觉证据以支撑临床决策。我们发现，剪除定位区域之外的视觉令牌能显著增强医学推理能力。然而，一个统一整合主动视觉令牌剪枝（VTP）与医学多模态推理的强化学习框架尚未建立。为此，我们提出双流强化学习框架ViToS，同时实现令牌剪枝与问答任务。ViToS训练一个包含两个任务分支的策略模型：一个分支专注于定位，另一个分支在VTP后进行令牌稀疏推理。此外，我们通过引入交叉反馈顺序优化解决了耦合策略学习问题，避免了梯度冲突并促进了共享策略模型的收敛。在七个医学基准上的评估表明，我们的方法将视觉令牌减少至原始序列长度的77%，同时在Lingshu-7B和HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B上分别实现了108.27%和104.16%的相对性能。总体而言，ViToS提供了卓越的性能和推理加速，为医学多模态推理建立了一种高效范式。

title: GRAPE: Graph-Augmented Prototype Explanations for Interactive Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Prototype-based medical image classifiers present three clinical limitations: they treat findings as independent, silently amplify unsafe physician feedback, and require full retraining whenever a new finding is needed. We present GRAPE (Graph-Augmented Prototype Explanations), a unified architecture that addresses all three challenges. First, a Graph Attention Task Head models anatomical concept co-occurrence, boosting macro-F1 by +13.8,pp over the prototype baseline on TBX11K. Second, a Concept-Mismatch Safety Check - the first such mechanism in prototype-based medical classifiers - warns when the model's dominant finding inside a doctor-drawn region conflicts with the claimed label, catching 85% of erroneous annotations versus 51% for MC-Dropout with no extra inference cost. Third, Open-Vocabulary Prototype Anchoring aligns visual prototypes to clinical text, allowing a new finding to be added from a single labeled image without modifying any other component. On NIH ChestX-ray14, one Effusion example recovers full-supervision localization accuracy; on TBX11K, prototype maps achieve 2.6x better lesion localization than end-to-end baselines. All three capabilities add only +1~ms latency at interactive batch size. The project page is https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/GRAPE.
tldr: GRAPE enhances prototype-based medical image diagnosis with a graph attention module for concept co-occurrence, a safety check to warn about mismatched annotations, and open-vocabulary prototype anchoring to add new findings from a single image, achieving significant improvements in lesion localization and error detection with minimal latency.
tldr_zh: GRAPE通过图注意力模块建模概念共现、安全检查机制警告错误标注、以及开放词汇原型锚定实现单图像添加新发现，从而提升基于原型的医学图像诊断性能，在病灶定位和错误检测上取得显著改进且延迟极低。
summary_zh: 基于原型学习的医学图像分类器存在三个临床局限性：将影像发现视为独立特征、在无警示情况下放大不安全的医师反馈，以及每当需要新增病灶类别时必须完整重新训练模型。本文提出GRAPE（图增强原型解释）统一架构，系统解决上述三个挑战。首先，图注意力任务头通过建模解剖概念共现模式，在TBX11K数据集上将宏F1分数较原型基线提升13.8个百分点。其次，概念失配安全检测机制——这是基于原型学习的医学分类器中首个此类机制——能在医生标注区域内的主导病灶与声明标签冲突时发出预警，以零额外推理成本捕获85%的错误标注（对比MC-Dropout方法的51%）。第三，开放词汇原型锚定技术将视觉原型与临床文本对齐，仅需单张带标注图像即可新增病灶类别，无需修改任何其他组件。在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集中，单张胸腔积液样本即可恢复全监督定位精度；在TBX11K数据集上，原型定位图实现病变定位效果较端到端基线提升2.6倍。上述三项功能在交互式批量处理时仅增加1毫秒延迟。项目主页：https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/GRAPE。

title: GaussLite: Online Task-Conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Robotic Mapping
summary: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) systems distribute representation capacity uniformly across a scene, ignoring the fact that many downstream robotic tasks engage only a fraction of the reconstructed geometry. This causes valuable onboard compute to be allocated towards optimizing irrelevant parts of the scene, either limiting online capacity or under-optimizing the most relevant parts of the scene. We introduce GaussLite, a task-driven 3DGS mapping system that conditions its representation density on a natural-language task specification. Given a posed RGB-D stream and a task such as "prepare to pick up the object on the desk," GaussLite uses a one-shot LLM parser to extract target and anchor objects, which are grounded per-frame by an open-vocabulary detector and segmented to produce per-pixel relevance masks in real time. The mapper allocates seeding density, gradient flow and scaling by task relevance. At matched Gaussian budget and real-time mapping at 4 Hz on resource-constrained hardware, GaussLite outperforms baselines on ROI PSNR on the Replica Dataset by an average +2.72 dB and on a real-hardware demonstration in indoor and outdoor settings by +2.23 dB. We further show that two task-specialized agents' maps can be fused into a single shared map via per-voxel voting on active-optimization counts in real time, outperforming concatenation by +3.42 dB while only sharing an average 7.08% of the map.
tldr: GaussLite introduces a task-driven 3D Gaussian Splatting mapper that uses a natural-language task specification to focus representation density on relevant scene regions, enabling real-time mapping on resource-constrained hardware with improved ROI PSNR.
tldr_zh: GaussLite 提出了一种任务驱动的3D高斯溅射建图系统，通过自然语言任务描述引导表示密度集中于场景相关区域，在资源受限硬件上实现实时建图并提升感兴趣区域PSNR。
summary_zh: 现有3D高斯溅射（3DGS）系统将表征能力均匀分布在整个场景中，却忽略了大多数下游机器人任务仅涉及重建几何体的一小部分这一事实。这导致宝贵的机载计算资源被分配给场景中无关部分的优化，从而限制在线计算能力或导致场景最相关部分优化不足。我们提出GaussLite——一种任务驱动的3DGS建图系统，其表征密度根据自然语言任务规范进行条件化配置。给定带姿态的RGB-D数据流和诸如"准备拾取桌上的物体"等任务时，GaussLite采用单次LLM解析器提取目标对象与锚定对象，并通过开放词汇检测器逐帧定位，实时分割生成逐像素相关性掩膜。该建图器根据任务相关性分配播种密度、梯度流与缩放参数。在匹配高斯预算及资源受限硬件上实现4Hz实时建图的条件下，GaussLite在Replica数据集上的ROI PSNR指标平均优于基线方法+2.72 dB，在室内外真实硬件演示中提升+2.23 dB。我们进一步证明，两个任务专用智能体的地图可通过逐体素对活跃优化计数进行实时投票融合为单一共享地图，该方案较简单串联方式提升+3.42 dB，且平均仅需共享7.08%的地图内容。
